rapid_fire.name: Rapid Fire
rapid_fire.description: Fires 3 quick shots at 120% power each. Good for breaking through defense.

power_slash.name: Power Slash
power_slash.description: A devastating melee strike at 250% power. High damage, long cooldown.

guard_break.name: Guard Break
guard_break.description: Reduces enemy defense by 50% for 3 turns, then deals normal damage.

barrage.name: Barrage
barrage.description: Unleashes 5 rapid strikes at 80% power. Total damage potential is massive.

overdrive.name: Overdrive
overdrive.description: Ultimate technique. A single strike at 400% power. Very long cooldown.

tank_cannon_barrage.name: Cannon Barrage
tank_cannon_barrage.description: Fires the main cannon 3 times at 150% power. Devastating against single targets.

tank_smokescreen.name: Smokescreen
tank_smokescreen.description: Deploys smoke grenades. Increases evasion by 80% for 3 turns.

tank_missile_swarm.name: Missile Swarm
tank_missile_swarm.description: Launches a swarm of missiles. 4 hits at 130% power. Requires SE unit.

field_medic.name: Field Medic
field_medic.description: Emergency first aid. Restores 40% of max HP.

toxic_strike.name: Toxic Strike
toxic_strike.description: A tainted blade strike that poisons the enemy for 4 turns.

incendiary_round.name: Incendiary Round
incendiary_round.description: Fires a phosphorus round that burns the enemy for 3 turns.

battle_focus.name: Battle Focus
battle_focus.description: Enters a focused state, boosting attack by 60% for 3 turns.

iron_wall.name: Iron Wall
iron_wall.description: Takes a fortified stance, boosting defense by 80% for 3 turns.

enemy_poison_spit.name: Poison Spit
enemy_poison_spit.description: Spits toxic venom that poisons the target.

enemy_heal_protocol.name: Repair Protocol
enemy_heal_protocol.description: Self-repair system. Restores 25% of max HP.
